data.description:
**3D Coverage Everywhere**

- Almost every recognizable city on Earth is available in True 3D, even my tiny Romanian hometown is covered, so you are likely able to visit your own street in Immersive 3D

- Best 3D Earth Quality on the market with the new **'Upscale 3D Imagery'** feature

**Street View**

- Best UNCOMPRESSED 8k Quality on the market, with every street 360 and community panorama on Earth

**Multiplayer**

- Explore alongside your friends

**(Add-on) ChatGPT Integration: EarthQuest AI can**

- Naturally respond in YOUR OWN Language
- Visualize & understand your surroundings on Earth for any educational purpose or to simply give fun facts
- Teleport you anywhere on Earth when asked
- .. and much more

**Realistic Graphics**

- Realistic lighting based on the customizable day/night cycle
- Lifelike adaptive 'Fog' option

**Hand Tracking**

- Fly like a Superhero by pointing your index finger
- Rotate by doing a "Steering" gesture with your own hands

**Terrain Quality**

- The 3D Map Quality can go much further than anything else out there and achieve realistic 3D by pushing the map quality to extreme detail with the best possible performance

**Comfort Settings**

- Comfort Options ( Snap Turning / Flight Vignette ) to prevent Motion Sickness
- Flight Input Remapping ( Flight Controls Range from Simple to Cinematic Movement )

**Google Maps Integration**

- Smart / manual zoom based on altitude
- Paired with the compass for body orientation
- Fully integrated Google Maps functionality

**.. out of space, check "earthquest.site" ..**

v44 is OUT !

# Bookmark Slot Renaming

-  You can now **rename** saved Bookmark Slots !

# Additional

- Compass now visible (from underneath) on both sides, handy when looking up !

- Fixed Fog covering up the Sky in some weird scenarios, and other bugs

———
v43.5 is HERE !

# Mini-map Updates

- Discover nearby Community Street Views, See Official Street View Coverage on a larger scale, and more with the new Street View Coverage Overlay Toggle !

- Improved user-marker design 🔺 

- Reengineered zooming: zoom motion is no longer linear and feels much more natural, and altitude-based auto zoom is more intuitive and responsive overall 🔎✨

- Added new zoom-in level, offering the ability to zoom closer in for even more details about your location 📍 

# Additional

- Varied smaller improvements, UI refinements, and bug fixes

- Refined UI Color-Scheme, featuring a fresher, more “pearly” blue !

- Small optimizations for performance

———

Let me know if there are any issues, big OR small - ( contact.earthquest.site )

v43 is HERE !

# Better Bookmarks Management

- You can now better organize your bookmarks with the ability to empty unused slots

- To empty a slot, simply load that slot ( be at that saved position ) and press ‘Save Location’; Now, instead of overwriting, you will be able to empty it 🧹 !

# Introducing Autocompleted ‘Search For Place’ locations !

- Autocompleted ‘Search For Place’ location results !

# Additional 

- New magical Soundtrack in EarthQuest’s music library

- Improved Render Accuracy for Human-Size (no performance costs)

- Some optimizations were made to Fog Rendering, expect small performance improvements when Fog is enabled.

- Small varied improvements, UI refinements, bug fixes

v42.5 is here !

# Street View improvements

- Optimized Street View system, allowing fastest possible loading times on any type of Street View Imagery

- Slightly smoother performance when a panorama is first being loaded

# Introducing Featured Locations !

- Renamed `Saved Locations` to `Bookmarks`

- Enjoy 27 featured breathtaking places, highlighted on the first 1-4 pages of `Bookmarks`.   |   Note: these will only take your unoccupied slots

- Saving to an occupied slot will now ask for confirmation, seamlessly preventing accidentally replacing it

# Additional 

- New Soundtrack !! - https://youtu.be/6tvgcSUaQ5Q

- Safely allocated slightly more memory for loading 3D Maps

- AI can now translate ANY TEXT from Street View Imagery !

- Maximum AI recording time should no longer limit longer recordings, it is now extended from 30s to 80s

Let me know if there are any issues, big OR small - ( contact.earthquest.site )

v42 is finally here !

This is an interesting one.

- As previously announced, Personal API is no longer available, the functionality can still be functional but it is removed from the interface and is no longer recommended. For more details see <http://faq.earthquest.site>

# Big Hub Menu Redesign 

- The API interface is gone, so we’re taking advantage of this opportunity to improve the overall simplicity & design.

A new feature / option was also introduced in v42, which is

- Display Refresh Rate, offering control over battery consumption & GPU performance.

—Available in the Hub Settings Menu

———
# Auto-adjusting Controller Cursor visibility !

- The Controller Selection Cursors will now fade away when too far away from UI, keeping the experience free from distractions and resulting in a much more seamless, immersive and satisfying experience !

- Smoothly integrated and fully adaptive to Keyboard / Menu states

# Other Improvements

- The How to Play interface will now only show the input scheme and reminder of how to use when first loading in, keeping everything simple and easy to understand.

- Perfectly balanced sun intensity & warm-shade strength at horizon

Let me know if there are any issues, big OR small - ( contact.earthquest.site )

v41 is RELEASED !

Didn't expect it so soon did ya ?

# AI Controller Hotkey

- Effortlessly use AI with no countdown or menu interaction !

- Properly integrated, cannot be accidentally triggered, and offers introductory visual explanation on how to use

# AI Improvements

- AI Visualization now utilizes 3.29x more resolution ( 228% more quality )

- AI can now properly visualize your perspective in Space

- Fixed seeing Markdown Syntax ( ** ) in AI responses

- If the AI usage limit every few hours wasn’t already generous, now it’s even higher / harder to reach !

# Additional

- A considerate amount of polishing, behavior refinement for better reliability, and bug fixes.

- Wind will no longer be heard when flying with Flight Speed 0.1x 

- Careful small refinements made to Thumbstick Smooth Rotation, preventing accidentally turning when the Thumbstick is tilted very slightly. Additionally resulting in more responsive 'Thumbstick Flight Input Mode' controls.

- FINALLY Solved the rare, mysterious crash that happened immediately after loading in.

- Improved Street View nearby 360 detection and usage

Let me know if there are any issues, big OR small ( contact.earthquest.site )
